messages.subject: problem with stratum categories
parts:
Hi,

=20

I have done point bird surveys in 6 vegetation types (155 points in
total, most surveys were repeated 6 days in the same points, but some
were repeated only 3 days), and I would like to estimate densities in
each one of the vegetation types, but I am running into a weird problem.
Each time I import the data from a text file, instead of 6 categories,
the program generates 32. I tried simplifying the data by importing only
vegetation type (as a region), point id (as sample), and the distance
records (observation), and effort (sample), and changing the names of
those vegetation types to level numbers instead of text. But the program
still generates 32 categories when it comes to calculate density by
stratum (using the regular CDS estimation with vegetation type as
stratum). In other words, I get more than one estimate for vegetation
type 1, more than one estimate for veg type 2, etc., and they are all
different! I don't know what else to try and don't understand what is
going on. Does anyone have any suggestion? Any comments will be
appreciated. Thanks,

=20

Christine

=20

Christine N. Meynard

PhD Candidate, Graduate Group in Ecology

Dept. Env. Sci. & Policy

University of California, Davis
